verdict.rationale: A recorded dry run of `ultrametric init` shows it writing SKILL.md files into both Codex's `.agents/skills/` and Claude Code's `.claude/skills/` directories. The docs say these skill files can be committed and shared, so the skill format works with more than one vendor's harness. No evidence explicitly states conformance to the open Agent Skills specification, or shows that the same folder is valid as-is beyond those two targets. Missing for 10: explicit documented Agent Skills spec conformance, evidence of SKILL.md frontmatter/structure matching the spec, independent validation that one skill folder works across arbitrary spec-compliant tools.
